description: This file defines an interface ITransactionalBitArrayGrain for transactional bit array grain in Orleans, including methods for pinging, setting bits, and retrieving states, with transaction options.

classes.name: ITransactionalBitArrayGrain
classes.description: Interface for transactional operations on a bit array grain with methods for setting bits and retrieving their states within Orleans transactions.

methods.name: Ping
methods.description: Checks connectivity or liveness of the grain.

methods.name: SetBit
methods.description: Sets a bit to a new value within a transaction context.

methods.name: Get
methods.description: Retrives the list of BitArrayState objects through a transactional read.
